plain: Primary Button hover is the solid accent hover fill, secondary Button pressed a solid overlay fill, a disabled secondary Button a lighter border, and neutral Badge the solid overlay surface; Badge gains --component-badge-<tone>-bg and -text, the flat -bg and -text are deprecated.

steps.plain: A disabled secondary button now draws a lighter border (border.subdued), so it reads as disabled; nothing to change unless you styled against the old darker border.
